Name: Sweet Simple Greenhouse with Cellar
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][size=4][b][u]features[/u][/b][/size]

⋆ greenhouse space designed to fit all fruit trees and iridium sprinklers
⋆ stairs down to optional cellar space for placing kegs/casks/whatever
⋆ option to unlock cellar only when farmhouse is fully upgraded
⋆ seasonal background that works with all recolours


[size=4][b][u]config options[/u][/b][/size]

⋆ WoodPanelsColour: Vanilla, Dark, or Light
⋆ EnableCellar: true or false
⋆ UnlockCellarWithHouseUpgrade: true or false


[size=4][b][u]installation[/u][/b][/size]

1. download [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. extract all mod folders from .zips to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. edit the config.json file to customise options
4. run the game with SMAPI to play
